purpose: Every ADMITTED transport-ensemble member (transport_ensemble_v0.json 'members') must carry an 'admission' block with these fields. abep_sim/hall_ensemble.load_ensemble() verifies it offline: the referenced decision and scores-provenance files must exist, match their recorded sha256, and the decision must list the member as PROMOTABLE with the recorded passing layer-1 members. Screening candidates can never produce design Hall maps; nothing can be admitted by editing the list by hand.

required_fields.promoted_from_screening_id: the screening_candidates id this member was promoted from (must equal ensemble_member_id)
required_fields.preregistration: path (relative to hallthruster_bridge/) of the frozen acceptance criteria
required_fields.decision_file: path (relative to hallthruster_bridge/) of the mechanical decision file (scripts/report_p5_n2_campaign.py)
required_fields.scores_provenance_file: path of the score-once provenance manifest (scripts/score_p5_n2_frozen.py)
required_fields.passing_layer1_members: non-empty list of global layer-1 members (registration|coil|reading) that passed; calibration nuisance stays provenance, never a parameter
required_fields.o4_dispositions_file: path (relative to hallthruster_bridge/) of the owner's O4 dispositions record (ensemble/o4_dispositions_schema_v1.json)

evidence_matrix_note: The Xe screening evidence that selected a candidate and the new evidence that promoted it are recorded separately (screening_rule / admission.campaign_id); the same evidence is never counted twice.
amendment_2026_09_26: Owner follow-up on PR #29, made before any admission record existed: a PROMOTABLE mandatory-vacuum result alone never admits a member or enables design Hall maps. The O4 first stage (every pre-registered staged sensitivity, scored against its baseline) and every escalation its trigger requires must be scored (scripts/score_p5_n2_staged.py) and dispositioned by the owner before admission; load_ensemble() verifies this offline (_check_o4).
promotion_evidence_rule_2026_09_26: Owner decision (Question A disposition): a campaign scored on the same P5-N2 measurements after the v1 results were known (e.g. a model-domain v2) is NOT new evidence for promoting a screening candidate. The admission's campaign must supply genuinely new predictive evidence not used in selecting the closure: held-out or previously unused experimental conditions, new independently published measurements, or a new common-condition experiment.
